what: Florida homes with no sale since 1 Jan 2025 (SALE_YR1=0 and SALE_YR2=0 on the 2026 statewide roll), clicked on the live page by point and by drawn lot. Run 1: Broward and Orange. Run 2: Broward again, because one Coral Springs click in run 1 got no answer from the statewide parcel layer (the same point query took 23.6 s by curl right after; the page waits 12 s, then 15 s by JSONP).
